data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Verify the retention policy is correctly configured for 'Deleted Files' and 'Trash Bin' in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies apply to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery, not automatic purging by retention policies unless specifically configured to purge Trash after X days. [T-2063] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
